title: Quranic Software Terminology Standard — dictionary entry

concept.description: Unique key for the entry. Identical to `code`.

plural.description: Code plural. English +s, never an Arabic plural (§11).

kind.description: Structural role of the entry. Closed list — never a domain (§12).

category.description: Domain the entry belongs to (§25). One list, shared with the dictionary's sections.

parent.description: The entry this one is a kind of: the classification a value belongs to, or the family a mark belongs to (§14). Required when kind is classification_value. Never used for containment: that is `part_of`.

part_of.description: The entity this one is a part of, not a kind of: rubu_al_hizb is part of hizb, mushaf_edition is part of mushaf. Optional; distinct from `parent`.

registry.description: The registry in standards/terminology/registries/ that enumerates this concept's members (§13): the file name without .tsv. A concept with a closed set of members names it here instead of giving each member an entry.

origin.description: quranic: a specialized Quranic concept keeping its Arabic name. borrowed: a general technical or linguistic term with a settled definition elsewhere. standard: a concept this standard defines for software modeling with no traditional counterpart.

tier.description: core: concepts applications actually store. extended: real but rarely modeled, or with disputed boundaries.

symbol.description: The character a mark is rendered with. Applies to kind: mark and to the drawn values of waqf_mark_type.

definition.description: What is it? No implementation detail, no circularity (§15).

definition_en.description: The definition in English. A translation of `definition`, never a second definition: both say the same thing.

purpose.description: Why do we model it? Never a restatement of the definition (§16).

purpose_en.description: The purpose in English. A translation of `purpose`.

boundaries.description: What the concept does not include (§17).

boundaries_en.description: The boundaries in English, line for line with `boundaries`.

alternative_spellings.description: Every attested spelling. Generated into the alias index so any of them resolves to this concept. Never an English gloss (§19).

english_glosses.description: English words a reader may search by (Verse, Chapter). Search keys, not names to write with; a gloss is never an alternative spelling.

deprecated.description: Names this concept was known by that are wrong, not merely alternative: they are kept out of the alias index.

sources.description: Citations for the concept's definition, not for the choice of code name (§28).

ref.description: Where in the source, in the form sources.yml states for it: a page as volume/page ("1/60"), a dictionary term id ("122"), a corpus id, or sheet!row for a registry.

names.description: One concept, several names. Each field does one job; they are allowed to disagree.

code.description: Identifier: code, APIs, databases, datasets. Derived by sections 4-8 with no exceptions.

display.description: Human-facing English for docs and UI. The dominant established form, measured, not chosen.

display_evidence.description: Why this display form: the measurement that settled it, e.g. 'GitHub phrase search 478 vs 118'.

transliteration.description: Precise scholarly rendering (ALA-LC / DIN 31635), with diacritics. Optional.

singular.description: The unvocalized singular, as it is typed and searched for.

plural.description: The unvocalized Arabic plural, for search. Never the code plural (§11).

vocalized.description: Fully vocalized. The input the code spelling is derived from, so it is the one field no tool can supply.

dabt.description: The technical name in علم الضبط.

by_shape.description: The name describing how the mark is drawn.

mushaf_introduction.description: The name in the Mushaf's own introduction. Null means the introduction does not name it, which is a fact about the source.

unicode.description: The character's Unicode name. Recorded, never used as the code name.

mark_family.description: The mushaf registry's own grouping of marks, kept as recorded. The dictionary's grouping is `parent`; the two are reconciled by tools/generate_dabt.py. Applies to kind: mark and to the drawn values of waqf_mark_type.

unicode.description: Generated from the Unicode database; never hand-written. Applies to kind: mark and to the drawn values of waqf_mark_type.

unidata.description: Version of the Unicode database the block was read from, e.g. "15.1.0".
